entries.content: Step 1 — Material Recognition: Acknowledge that your addiction was a response to a world designed to crush you. Admit that you cannot overcome a systemic poison through individual will alone.
entries.name: Step 1: Material Recognition

entries.content: Step 2 — Collective Hope: Realize that while the system is designed to isolate you, there is a collective power in shared struggle that can provide the stability you lack.
entries.name: Step 2: Collective Hope

entries.content: Step 3 — Surrender to Solidarity: Let go of the illusion that you must be the sole architect of your survival. Trust in the support of others and the process of mutual aid.
entries.name: Step 3: Surrender to Solidarity

entries.content: Step 4 — Dialectical Inventory: Conduct a rigorous, honest analysis of your life. Identify the contradictions between who you are and who the system forced you to become.
entries.name: Step 4: Dialectical Inventory

entries.content: Step 5 — Social Accountability: Admit your faults and the harm you've caused to another human being and to the collective. Own your history without shame, but with clarity.
entries.name: Step 5: Social Accountability

entries.content: Step 6 — Readiness for Evolution: Become entirely ready to shed the survival mechanisms that no longer serve you, preparing your mind for a new way of existing.
entries.name: Step 6: Readiness for Evolution

entries.content: Step 7 — Active Transformation: Ask for the strength to change your habits and your consciousness, moving from a state of passive suffering to active liberation.
entries.name: Step 7: Active Transformation

entries.content: Step 8 — Reparative Mapping: Create a list of all those you've harmed. Analyze the nature of that harm through a lens of accountability and restorative justice.
entries.name: Step 8: Reparative Mapping

entries.content: Step 9 — Direct Amends: Make direct reparations to those people wherever possible, focusing on healing the social bond rather than just seeking forgiveness.
entries.name: Step 9: Direct Amends

entries.content: Step 10 — Continuous Audit: Maintain a daily practice of self-reflection. When you are wrong, promptly admit it to your community to prevent the buildup of ego or resentment.
entries.name: Step 10: Continuous Audit

entries.content: Step 11 — Conscious Connection: Seek a deeper connection to the rhythms of nature and the history of human struggle, moving beyond the ego to find peace in the broader flow of existence.
entries.name: Step 11: Conscious Connection

entries.content: Step 12 — Revolutionary Outreach: Having found liberation through solidarity, you dedicate yourself to helping others break their chains, treating every act of support as a seed for a new world.
entries.name: Step 12: Revolutionary Outreach
